nodes.description: Payable fallback receive() function of contract Bait; allows the contract to accept plain Ether transfers with empty body.
External function bait(address _pickpocket) that forwards an attacker-supplied address into a delegatecall of finesse(address), executing arbitrary external code in the storage context of Bait.
Caller-supplied address parameter of bait(); fully controllable destination of the delegatecall and therefore an attacker-controlled code pointer.
Low-level delegatecall to _pickpocket with selector finesse(address); executes untrusted external code inside Bait's context, enabling state manipulation/selfdestruct of Bait.

edges.reason: bait() unconditionally performs the delegatecall on the caller-supplied address and only checks the returned success flag, so the function body drives the unsafe operation.

The value of parameter _pickpocket flows directly into the delegatecall target, letting an attacker re-enter and execute arbitrary code in Bait's storage context (attacker-controlled callee / external call to untrusted address).
The external entrypoint bait() takes the untrusted address parameter, so the parameter provides the access path that reaches the privileged delegatecall execution.
Bait declares a payable receive() fallback, so value or plain calls sent during/after the delegatecall-based interaction can re-enter the contract through the fallback function.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter _pickpocket is a non-core node whose only semantic role is to supply the callee address of the unsafe delegatecall, so it should be normalized into that unsafe_operation.
